passives.name: SinbadEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
Every {1} seconds summon a $LightningStrike on the strongest enemy in this unit's range:
- $LightningStrike deals {2}% of this unit's damage
- $LightningStrike will chain between {3} enemies
- Each chain deals {4}% of this unit's current damage
- Each chain will also apply $Freeze
